obligations.title: Atomic committed settings
obligations.behavior: Latest queued local state merges before atomic replacement; failed writes preserve prior state. Exact committed replies cannot replace newer observed cache state.
obligations.currentSource: Serialized storage updateLocalState/updateLocalStateAndGet; monotonic local-state-cache helper.
obligations.judgment: Current exact source and focused storage/cache/main-operation proof; ordinary fresh process, not physical-disk failure or power loss.

obligations.title: Radio setup drafts
obligations.behavior: Setup fields, pending saves and errors survive music/shared-management navigation; wrong-profile/older completion preserves newer drafts.
obligations.currentSource: Account-owned SessionContent configDraft; submitted-reference equality; expected profile checked again inside queued commit.
obligations.judgment: Retained guarded native/service cases composed with current source and fresh unsaved mood detours.

obligations.title: General device preferences
obligations.behavior: General drafts/pending/failures survive navigation and music-account changes; separate forms block own duplicates and preserve newer unrelated playback choices.
obligations.currentSource: SettingsEditsProvider above account key; independent useEdit owners and synchronous input/write locks; canonical queued field patch results.
obligations.judgment: Retained actual account/navigation and field-race cases plus current receipt proof. Fresh native cadence draft survives page detours and is discarded only at relaunch.

obligations.title: Account-scoped drafts
obligations.behavior: Radio script/setup and inline playlist state survive same-account expiry/recovery; sign-out or another identity discards that owner and old callbacks cannot edit its replacement.
obligations.currentSource: SessionContent identity key owns radio states/recovery above its conditional ReadyApp/ConnectionPage. Old setters belong to the old owner.
obligations.judgment: Current ownership/callback inspection composed with retained account and recovery cases; no fresh complete multi-account sweep.

obligations.title: Library choice lifetime
obligations.behavior: Library checkbox drafts/pending/errors survive navigation; accepted authentication resets them, and expiry/stale callbacks cannot reopen the wrong session.
obligations.currentSource: LibrarySelectionProvider revision, current account/expiry, active owner and accepted completion checks; serialized connection/library writes.
obligations.judgment: Original native/service cases retained with current auth-handoff helper match. Live C06 is an actual grant, not arbitrary permission configurations.

obligations.title: Provider-key lifetime
obligations.behavior: Masked key drafts/pending/errors survive navigation; identity changes clear text/settled errors while active device-wide writes remain locked. Confirmed key/status reads stay authoritative.
obligations.currentSource: Above-account ProviderKeyEdits with explicit session revision; submission/useIsMutating lock; provider read revision.
obligations.judgment: Current key owner exactly matches tested source; retain protected OS-storage boundaries. No personal key accessed.

obligations.title: Script and audio integrity
obligations.behavior: Dirty script replacement needs consent; cancel/failure preserve text and late text completion cannot overwrite a newer draft. Committed takes/artifacts retain their documented restart/cancellation lifetime.
obligations.currentSource: requestScript/prepareText confirmation, captured draft identity guard; durable prepared-news scripts/takes/selection/request identity.
obligations.judgment: Current matching confirmation/identity nodes and current CI4/CI5 data proof compose. No new billed generation, audio quality or forced crash.

obligations.title: Profile operations
obligations.behavior: Copy/switch/availability/preparation-off preserve unrelated drafts and show committed profile after failed refresh without write replay. Copies remain off/unavailable.
obligations.currentSource: Canonical serialized operations; clear only submitted matching references; independent UI guards.
obligations.judgment: Current actual operations and native failed-readback setup/copy/switch. Resume/off/availability side effects use main-operation/source evidence, not new native permutations.

obligations.title: Dialog-local edits
obligations.behavior: Shared source/DJ and playlist dialogs keep drafts/items through definite failure/pending; ordinary dismissal may discard local drafts. Confirmed shared changes remain visible after failed readback.
obligations.currentSource: Modal-local drafts, duplicate and pending-dismissal guards; shared receipt/cache helper; playlist uncertainty journal.
obligations.judgment: PR119 current native/service result plus retained failure/pending proof. No claim unsaved names survive Cancel or Quit.

obligations.title: Durable playlist recovery
obligations.behavior: Confirmed playlist data stays server-owned; uncertain edits retain account-owned recovery through navigation/restart, and old receipts cannot authorize another account.
obligations.currentSource: SessionContent usePlaylistRecovery plus opaque durable journal, account-bound read/acknowledgement receipts and no automatic replay.
obligations.judgment: Current owner/journal source matches retained native/service/restart evidence. Not arbitrary live mutation, crash or missing permission configuration proof.

obligations.title: Temporary music selections
obligations.behavior: Song/open-album selections survive navigation; explicit album Back/open, library/account changes and restart end temporary album lifetime.
obligations.currentSource: ReadyApp SongsView/AlbumsView; parent-selected maps; explicit Back/open reset; updateLibraries reset; account/process initialization.
obligations.judgment: Fresh current native selection/Back/relaunch checks below. Library/account reset uses current inspected ownership plus retained cases. Unresolved old TrackTable hash is excluded from current table proof.

obligations.title: Window and process lifetime
obligations.behavior: macOS Close hides the same window without saving/discarding drafts or canceling authorized work; activation restores it. Quit ends transient drafts and relaunch restores durable music paused.
obligations.currentSource: Current close interception, activate and before-quit exactly match accepted lifecycle source; React owners live with window/process; durable storage/journals remain separate.
obligations.judgment: Retained actual native Close/activate and quit exit; fresh owned-process quit/relaunch against same data restores identical saved duplicate queue/options paused while clearing drafts/selections. Not paid-hidden-work, power loss or desktop chrome acceptance.
